consent.title: Data Processing Consent
consent.subtitle: Before starting your interview, please review and consent to our data processing practices.

videoRecording.title: Video Recording
videoRecording.description: We will record your video during the interview for analysis purposes. This includes facial expressions and body language.

audioRecording.title: Audio Recording
audioRecording.description: We will record your voice during the interview for speech analysis and transcription.

aiAnalysis.title: AI Analysis
aiAnalysis.description: Your responses will be analyzed using artificial intelligence to assess communication skills, confidence, and other relevant metrics.

dataRetention.title: Data Retention
dataRetention.description: Video/audio recordings will be stored for 30 days, transcripts for 90 days, and analysis results for 1 year.

dataUsage.title: Data Usage
dataUsage.description: Your data will be used solely for interview evaluation and will not be shared with third parties without your explicit consent.

withdrawConsent.title: Withdraw Consent
withdrawConsent.description: You can withdraw your consent at any time by contacting us. This will stop further processing of your data.

consent.required: All consents are required to proceed with the interview.
consent.declineMessage: Unfortunately, we cannot proceed with the interview without your consent to data processing.

interview.title: AI Interview
interview.question: Question
interview.confirmFinish: Are you sure you want to finish the interview?
interview.cannotPause: This interview cannot be paused once started.

errors.permission: Permission denied. Please check your camera and microphone settings.
